From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@novatia.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Model suitability follow-up & perf links

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Recap and recommended next steps below so we have a clean mutual action plan.

Call highlights
- Primary goal: real-time customer support assistant for Novatia's dashboard (avg prompt ~450 tokens, 1–3 references)
- Peak concurrency target: ~60 concurrent users during business hours; expected p50 request size 600 tokens, p95 1.2k
- Quality tolerance: high precision on retrieval and short-form answers; limited hallucination tolerance

Redwood recommendations (shortlist)
1) redwood-llama-70b-q4f (recommended pilot) — balance of quality and cost; good with our prompt pack and prefix caching
   - Verified baseline: 480 TPS (batching enabled), p50 latency ~85ms, p95 ~220ms at test concurrency=48 on Dedicated-4 GPU pool
2) guanaco-13b-qlora (fallback/smaller) — useful for bursty queries or if cost sensitivity rises
   - Verified baseline: 1,300 TPS (more aggressive batching), p50 ~35ms, p95 ~120ms under same test conditions

Quality/regression guardrails
- We'll run your core 150-case prompt set (attached: prompt_set_v1.txt) in the Redwood eval harness before pilot.
- Suggest a baseline eval pass and a regression alert at >5% drop in answer precision for named-entity questions.

Links and artifacts
- Benchmark summary (CSV): attached (benchmark_summary.csv)
- Shared Drive with traces & traces-to-repro: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novatia-eval
- Perf profiles: https://redwood.app/docs/perf-profiles#redwood-llama-70b-q4f

Next steps
1) Novatia: confirm two pilot accounts and SSO domain (Samir) — target by next Tue 6/1
2) Redwood: provision Dedicated test pool + run eval sweep on prompt_set_v1 (I will schedule, aim to share results by 6/3)
3) Technical sync (30m) to align telemetry and rollout criteria — proposed Wed 6/2 10am PT

Attachments: [Attachment: prompt_set_v1.txt (text)], [Attachment: benchmark_summary.csv (csv)]

Thanks — Priya

Thanks Priya — this is super helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we confirm the pilot accounts:

1) When you quote TPS for redwood-llama-70b-q4f, is that with KV-cache enabled and request-side batching? We expect a mix of short and long context (some sessions will have conversation history ~2k tokens).
2) For the regression alert, can we tune the threshold per intent? Our product team is particularly sensitive about the billing dispute flow.

Samir — can you confirm SSO domain and whether we want Prod-like data or anonymized samples for the initial eval?

On Fri, May 28, 2027 at 9:44 AM Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@novatia.com> wrote:
> Thanks Priya — this is super helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we confirm the pilot accounts:
>
> 1) When you quote TPS for redwood-llama-70b-q4f, is that with KV-cache enabled and request-side batching? We expect a mix of short and long context (some sessions will have conversation history ~2k tokens).
> 2) For the regression alert, can we tune the threshold per intent? Our product team is particularly sensitive about the billing dispute flow.

Good questions — short answers below.

1) The quoted numbers for redwood-llama-70b-q4f are from our Dedicated-4 runs with KV caching and continuous batching enabled (typical batch windows configured to 12–20ms in the test harness). For very long contexts (2k+) we see p95 increase; in our trace set p95 for 2k contexts rose to ~380ms. We recommend enabling prefix/KV caching for multi-turn sessions — that preserves p50/p95 for the common short-turn paths you described.

2) Yes — regression thresholds can be intent-specific. We typically recommend a 5% global alert and tighter 2–3% thresholds for high-sensitivity flows like billing disputes. Redwood Optimize can automate daily evals and send regression alerts to your Slack webhook or PagerDuty.

Pilot inputs we need from Novatia
- Two pilot accounts (emails) + SSO domain
- One-week example data dump (anonymized or redacted) or 200 sample interactions for the eval harness

I'll provision the Dedicated test pool once you confirm the accounts (target provisioning takes ~24 hours). Attaching a short pilot manifest with rollout criteria.

Attachments: [Attachment: pilot_manifest.pdf (pdf)]

— Priya
